versions.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-routing skill.

- Supports routing Feishu group chat messages to designated agents based on chat_id.
- Defines four departments (太子, 中书省, 门下省, 尚书省) with distinct group and agent assignments.
- Implements routing rules to detect message source and delegate tasks to the appropriate sub-agent using sessions_spawn.
- Ensures sub-agent replies are relayed back to the original group by the main agent.
- Includes clear instructions and cautions on session handling and context retention.
